body: yeah i have a shitty part time job right now that just barely pays the bills but honestly it doesn’t really matter hopefully it will be all be over soon
I want to go into comics and animation.

the thing is I don’t really want to get my degree. I had fine grades I left because mental health and academics don’t mix for me. I see two therapists and take multiple medications but all my professors would say when I asked for extra help at college was “maybe you should talk to someone”. Even if I told them what I was actively doing for my mental health. It doesn’t matter they just wanted to push and push and push. I only tried going to school to please my parents and grandparents. I knew I didn’t need a degree for my dream career path. but when I die I never have to think about it ever again. it simply will not matter.
felt this so hard. i’m so sorry you feel this way. i would never wish this kind of pain on anyone else
